name: Epipolar Ray Intersection
aliases: Lift 2D Points to 3D via Epipolar Lines
definition: Calculates the 3D positions and depths corresponding to specified 2D points on epipolar lines defined by camera origins and directions, using image extrinsics and intrinsics.
summary: Epipolar Ray Intersection lifts 2D points to 3D by intersecting rays from target and source cameras, differing from orthographic methods by using perspective projection and from depth conversion by computing ray intersections.
